name: Oath: Chronicles of Empire and Exile

rounds.endCondition: Up to 8 rounds; from round 5 a die roll at round end may end the game; round 8 ends it automatically

categories.label: Empire wins (Chancellor / Citizen Oathkeeper)
categories.labelVi: Đế chế thắng (Chancellor / Citizen giữ Oathkeeper)
categories.hint: Stable-regime die roll succeeded, or war exhaustion with an Empire Oathkeeper.

categories.label: Exile wins as Usurper
categories.hint: An Exile holding the Oathkeeper title on its Usurper side wins in their Wake Phase.

categories.label: Exile wins as Visionary
categories.hint: An Exile completes the goal of their revealed Vision.

categories.label: Citizen wins as Successor
categories.hint: A Citizen meets their Successor goal when the Chancellor would otherwise win.

roles.label: Chancellor / Citizen Oathkeeper (Empire)
roles.winCondition: Fulfil the current oath (Supremacy, The People, Protection or Devotion) and win the end-of-round die roll in rounds 5-7 (6, 5-6, 3-6), or hold the Oathkeeper at the end of round 8.

roles.label: Exile Usurper
roles.winCondition: Hold the Oathkeeper title on its Usurper side at the start of own Wake Phase.

roles.label: Exile Visionary
roles.winCondition: Fulfil a revealed Vision's goal (Conquest, Rebellion, Sanctuary or Faith).

roles.label: Citizen Successor
roles.winCondition: Satisfy the Successor goal instead of the Chancellor when the Chancellor would win.

winCondition: No points. Four ways to end: Usurper Exile wins in Wake Phase; Visionary Exile completes a Vision goal; Stable Regime die roll in rounds 5-7 (Chancellor/Citizen Oathkeeper, a Citizen Successor may win instead); war exhaustion after round 8 resolves by priority Empire, then Usurper, then Visionary (Conquest > Rebellion > Sanctuary > Faith), else Empire default.

endCondition.description: Die roll from round 5; automatic end after round 8

notes: family: asymmetric-roles. Campaign game: the winner performs Chronicle actions that change the next game (not modelled). Official Leder Games rulebook (Law of Oath) could not be retrieved; details come from RulesPal and Wikipedia summaries and need checking against the official Law of Oath (die thresholds, priority order, Citizen rules). Solo and 1-player Vision modes not modelled.
